newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan federation seeks return to Sunday holiday.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan federation seeks return to Sunday holiday.

text.p: The Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry said all its member businesses, shops and markets will observe Sunday as the weekly holiday instead of Friday.
Federation president Ilyas Ahmed Bilour told a news conference on Thursday the current Friday Islamic weekend was affecting trade because many parts of the world opened for business on Friday.
He said the move would take effect from October 6.
"We are cut off for three-and-a-half days from the United States and for three days from Europe with the present system," he said.
"This decision is neither politically motivated nor against anyone," Bilour said of the decision that will reverse a 20-year-old order by former prime minister Zulfikar Ali Bhutto.
He said he had written to Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto, Zulfikar Ali Bhutto's daughter, asking her to endorse the decision.
